select user_id userId, login_name loginName, passwd passwd, nick_name nickname, tel tel, email email, gender gender, head_pic headPic, birth_date birthDate, introduction introduction, location_addr locationAddr, graduate_school graduateSchool, from db_user where login_name=#{loginName} and passwd = #{passwd} and state = '0'
